title: Used pneumatic tyres of rubber

review.classification: Current CPC 3.0 39260 names used pneumatic tyres of rubber. Nearby 39250 covers rubber scrap and 36120 covers finished retreads. WCO HS 2022 Chapter 40 Note 6 includes rubber definitively unusable as such due to wear within heading 40.04. Whole shape or a collection trip cannot decide the classification. Document individual suitability for retreading, grade and actual first purchase. The replaced historical scrap-to-material-recovery endpoint did not provide that evidence.
review.primary_evidence: Cash’s Tire Recycling Inc. Terms of Service section 5 specifies on-site inspection, conditional selection, payment and transfer of title for retreadable commercial casings. Some presented casings remain with the owner; a separately agreed disposal service is possible. Website service descriptions and FAQs establish the distinction between purchase, scrap handling and resale. They do not establish the mass, inspection result, absence of packaging, legal permits or acquisition of a particular lot.
review.measurement: Apply one normalisation to matched raw burdens and net first-accepted casing mass. Separate physical receipt from mere presentation; carrying stock and post-gate service retain original cohort identity. Compare the zero-purchase visit, external inspection, travel and electricity boundaries to avoid double counting. Exclude assumed previous burdens or avoided virgin tyres. The loose, unwrapped, dry route requires positive study-specific evidence.
review.readiness: Each language has seven atomic exchange cards. The manifest records all seven unbound identities, including the retreadable reference casing. Independent focused check performed 38 checks with zero skips and five missing-range warnings. Candidate/authored methodology requires site and receiver evidence; scientific approval, formal translation review and publication remain outstanding.
review.original_native_records: The verified Waste Tire record is a Product flow whose context concerns waste management and pyrolysis. It does not establish retreadable quality, or an actual waste-treatment exchange, and is unselected. The independent Mass/kg records support weighing. The native Energy property references version 01.00.000 of the unit group, whereas the inspected group is version 03.00.003; its MJ/kWh units support the physical meter while the actual supplier and supplier reference property remain unbound.
